name: com.pikasim/pikasim
title: PikaSim
description: Buy eSIMs, phone numbers and SMS codes from any AI. Checkout link or prepaid wallet. No KYC.

tools.name: search_esim_packages
tools.description: Search PikaSim eSIM plans by country code, region, or keyword. Returns BOTH product lines in separate buckets: DATA eSIMs and PHONE-NUMBER eSIMs (real carrier number + voice + SMS). Each result shows its packageCode in [brackets] for purchasing. Use type to narrow to one line.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., JP, US, DE)

type.description: Which product line to return: "data" (data-only eSIMs), "phone" (phone-number eSIMs with voice+SMS), or "all" (both, default)

tools.name: search_phone_plans
tools.description: Search PikaSim PHONE-NUMBER eSIMs — plans that include a REAL carrier phone number (not VoIP) with voice calls, SMS, and data. US plans give a real +1 number on AT&T and T-Mobile; local country plans cover the UK (UK number on EE), the Netherlands (Dutch number on KPN), Europe (French +33 number), Australia, Mongolia, Vietnam, and Maldives; global plans cover 160+ countries. Use this when a user wants to call or text, not just data. Each result shows its packageCode in [brackets] for purchase_phone_plan.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US for a real +1 number)

tools.name: get_package_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific plan (data eSIM OR phone-number eSIM): coverage, data, voice/SMS allowance, duration, price, networks, and purchase URL. Accepts the packageCode shown in [brackets] by the search tools.

packageCode.description: Package code from a search result (e.g., CKH001 for data, change-plus-7days-1gb for a phone plan)

tools.name: check_country_coverage
tools.description: Check what PikaSim plans cover a country. Returns TWO buckets: DATA eSIMs (count, price range, data amounts) and PHONE-NUMBER eSIMs (count, price range — a real carrier number with voice + SMS).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., JP, US, DE)

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get the USD price for a specific plan (data eSIM OR phone-number eSIM). Accepts the packageCode from any search result.

tools.name: get_phone_plan_pricing
tools.description: Get the USD price and voice/SMS/data allowance for a specific PHONE-NUMBER eSIM. Accepts the packageCode from search_phone_plans.

packageCode.description: Phone-plan package code from search_phone_plans (e.g., change-plus-7days-1gb)

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the PikaSim eSIM catalog (data eSIMs and phone-number eSIMs) by free-text query and/or ISO country code. Returns a list of matching plans, each with an id, a title (name + price), and a pikasim.com URL. Pass an id to the fetch tool for full details. Read-only.

query.description: Free-text search, may include a country name and/or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "Japan 10GB", "US phone plan", "DE")

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch full details for one PikaSim eSIM plan by the id returned from search: coverage, data, voice/SMS allowance, duration, price, networks, and its pikasim.com purchase URL. Read-only.

id.description: The plan id returned by the search tool (the packageCode)

tools.name: create_wallet
tools.description: Create a NEW PikaSim agent wallet for autonomous purchasing — no human, no browser, no account, no email, no KYC. Returns a wallet code + an ak_live_ API key + a small spend-only welcome credit (spendable on eSIM data only; SMS verification numbers need a deposit from $1), so you can immediately reconnect with the key (Authorization: Bearer ak_live_…) and buy an eSIM, phone number, or SMS verification number. Use this when the user has NO wallet yet and wants their agent to buy. If the user ALREADY has a wallet, do NOT create a new one — reconnect the existing wallet instead (ask them for it). You accept the Terms of Service (https://pikasim.com/tos) on the user's behalf by passing acceptTos=true.

acceptTos.description: Must be true: confirms the user accepts the PikaSim Terms of Service (https://pikasim.com/tos). Required to create the wallet.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Returns the prepaid spending balance of the connected PikaSim agent wallet, in USD. Read-only; makes no changes. Call this before purchase_esim or purchase_phone_plan to confirm sufficient funds, or any time you need the current balance. Requires a connected agent wallet (OAuth or ak_live_ key). If no wallet is connected, the result explains how to connect one.

tools.name: purchase_esim
tools.description: Purchase a DATA eSIM. Deducts from your prepaid agent wallet and returns order details with activation info (ICCID, QR code, SM-DP+). Use the packageCode from search_esim_packages. For a daily-reset "Unlimited" plan, also pass days (the number of days to buy). For phone-number eSIMs use purchase_phone_plan instead. With a connected wallet it charges the wallet; with NO wallet it charges nothing and returns a checkout link for this exact plan that the user pays on pikasim.com.

packageCode.description: The data-eSIM package code shown in [brackets] by search_esim_packages or get_package_details (e.g. P6ZMSDS1G). Phone-plan codes are not valid here; use purchase_phone_plan for those.

days.description: ONLY for daily-reset "Unlimited" plans (get_package_details shows "Type: Daily unlimited"): the number of days to purchase. Valid values: 3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 30. Required for those plans, and the total charged is the per-day price times this many days (minus a duration discount). Omit for fixed-data plans.

requestId.description: Idempotency key: generate a fresh UUID for each NEW purchase, and reuse the SAME value when retrying after a timeout or transport error — an identical retry returns the original order instead of charging again.

promoCode.description: Optional promo/discount code. Validated server-side; an invalid code rejects the order with the reason (nothing is charged). Only pass a code the user explicitly provided.

payWith.description: Only matters when a wallet is connected. "wallet" (default) charges the wallet. "checkout" charges nothing and returns a checkout link for this exact plan, for a user who wants to pay by card or crypto themselves instead of from the wallet.

tools.name: purchase_phone_plan
tools.description: Purchase a PHONE-NUMBER eSIM — a plan with a real carrier phone number (voice + SMS + data). Deducts from your prepaid agent wallet and returns order details with activation info (ICCID, QR code, SM-DP+). The real phone number is assigned by the carrier when the eSIM registers on the network and appears in the device settings after activation. Use the packageCode from search_phone_plans. Plans whose search result says "designated-date activation" REQUIRE activationDate. With a connected wallet it charges the wallet; with NO wallet it charges nothing and returns a checkout link for this exact plan that the user pays on pikasim.com.

packageCode.description: Phone-plan package code (use search_phone_plans to find codes, e.g., change-plus-7days-1gb)

activationDate.description: Activation date in YYYY-MM-DD — ONLY for plans marked "designated-date activation" in search results (e.g. the Australia phone plan), where it is REQUIRED and must be at least 2 and at most 60 days from today. Ask the user for their service start date. Omit for all other plans.

requestId.description: Idempotency key: generate a fresh UUID for each NEW purchase, and reuse the SAME value when retrying after a timeout or transport error — an identical retry returns the original order instead of charging again.

promoCode.description: Optional promo/discount code. Validated server-side; an invalid code rejects the order with the reason (nothing is charged). Only pass a code the user explicitly provided.

payWith.description: Only matters when a wallet is connected. "wallet" (default) charges the wallet. "checkout" charges nothing and returns a checkout link for this exact plan, for a user who wants to pay by card or crypto themselves instead of from the wallet.

tools.name: get_esim_status
tools.description: Returns the live status, remaining/used data, and expiration date for one eSIM you own, looked up by its ICCID. Read-only. Use this after a purchase to track an eSIM, or whenever a user asks "how much data is left" or "is my eSIM active". The ICCID is returned by purchase_esim/purchase_phone_plan and listed by list_orders. Requires a connected agent wallet (OAuth or ak_live_ key).

iccid.description: The ICCID (the eSIM's unique serial number) returned by purchase_esim, purchase_phone_plan, or list_orders

tools.name: topup_esim
tools.description: Adds more data (and on some plans voice/SMS) to an existing eSIM the user already owns, without issuing a new eSIM. This SPENDS the wallet balance and cannot be undone. First call get_topup_options with the same ICCID to get valid top-up package codes and prices, then pass one here. Use when a user wants to extend an eSIM that is running low rather than buy a new one. Requires a connected agent wallet (OAuth or ak_live_ key).

iccid.description: The ICCID of the eSIM to top up (from list_orders or a prior purchase)

packageCode.description: A top-up package code returned by get_topup_options for this ICCID (top-up codes differ from new-purchase codes)

requestId.description: Idempotency key: generate a fresh UUID for each NEW top-up, and reuse the SAME value when retrying after a timeout or transport error — an identical retry returns the original top-up instead of charging again.

promoCode.description: Optional promo/discount code. Validated server-side; an invalid code rejects the top-up with the reason (nothing is charged). Only pass a code the user explicitly provided.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Returns the order history for the connected wallet, newest first: each order's ID, package, status, cost, date, ICCID, and install link. Read-only and paginated. Use this to find a past purchase, retrieve an ICCID for get_esim_status, or show a user what they have bought. Results are scoped to this wallet only. Requires a connected agent wallet (OAuth or ak_live_ key).

limit.description: Number of orders per page (default 20, maximum 50)

tools.name: list_esims
tools.description: List every eSIM this wallet owns (the fleet view), newest first: ICCID, plan, order status, install link, and — for fleets of up to 8 — live remaining data inline. Read-only. Use this to answer "which eSIMs do I own / how much data is left" without already knowing an ICCID; then get_esim_status for any single eSIM's full detail. eSIMs only — SMS numbers are listed by list_sms_orders. Requires a connected agent wallet.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: The wallet ledger: every debit and credit (deposits, purchases, refunds) with amount, running balance, and description, newest first. Read-only and paginated; filter with type. Use this to reconcile spend or answer "where did the balance go" — check_balance only gives the current number.

tools.name: create_deposit
tools.description: Creates a payment invoice to add funds to the connected prepaid PikaSim Wallet, and returns a payment page link (the human can pay by card with 3D Secure, or crypto) plus per-coin crypto payment details. Accepts Bitcoin, Lightning, Monero, Zcash, USDT, and 50+ altcoins, or card on the payment page. Does not move funds itself; it returns an invoice the user pays externally, and the balance updates once the payment confirms. Use when check_balance is too low to purchase. Minimum deposit is $1 (no prepaid float required); the wallet balance is capped at $2,000, so a deposit that would push it past that is refused. A fully-autonomous agent holding crypto can pay WITHOUT a human: the tool returns native destinations for Lightning, Bitcoin on-chain, USDT (TRC-20/Tron), and Monero — pay the amount to any one of them. Crypto has no fee; card payments add a 2.9% processing fee on top of the credited amount. Balance is prepaid credit for purchases on PikaSim, never expires, and is not redeemable for cash. Requires a connected agent wallet (OAuth or ak_live_ key).

amount.description: Amount in whole US dollars to CREDIT to the wallet (minimum 1; e.g. 25 for a $25 deposit)

coin.description: Optional. The coin YOU intend to pay with. Lightning, Bitcoin and Monero destinations are always returned; pass USDT-TRON only if you will actually pay in USDT (TRC-20), since those addresses come from a small pool and are allocated on request.

tools.name: get_topup_options
tools.description: List available top-up packages for an existing eSIM, including price and data amount. Use this before topup_esim to find valid package codes. Requires an agent-wallet API key (ak_live_).

iccid.description: ICCID of the eSIM to get top-up options for

tools.name: cancel_esim
tools.description: Cancel an unused eSIM and receive a refund to your wallet balance. Only works if the eSIM has not been installed or activated. Requires an agent-wallet API key (ak_live_).

iccid.description: ICCID of the eSIM to cancel

tools.name: search_sms_services
tools.description: Search the SMS VERIFICATION service list — websites/apps a receive-only verification number can get a code for (Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram / Threads, ...). Not offered for financial services, gambling, or government / identity-proofing services; delivered codes are capped per service per wallet (5 per 24h, 20 per 30d). This is the SMS product line (no eSIM, nothing to install): the user gets a temporary phone number and reads the incoming code. Returns service names with their serviceId in [brackets], most relevant first, 100 per page. If the target service is not listed, search "Other" — the catch-all works for any site. Next step: get_sms_service_countries.

query.description: Service name to search for (e.g. "Telegram", "WhatsApp", "Tinder"). One short distinctive word works best. Omit to list the most popular services first.

page.description: 1-based page (100 services per page). The footer of each page says which page to request next.

tools.name: get_sms_service_countries
tools.description: List the countries offering a quick SMS verification number for one service, with live price, delivery success rate, and whether the number is a real mobile (non-VoIP) or VoIP line. Sorted by success rate — prefer high success rates, and prefer non-VoIP when the target service blocks virtual numbers. Returns each countryId in [brackets] for order_sms_verification.

serviceId.description: The serviceId from search_sms_services (e.g. "395"), or an exact service name

tools.name: list_sms_rentals
tools.description: List long-term SMS RENTAL numbers: keep the same receive-only number for days to months and receive multiple SMS (fair-use 25/day). Shows each country with its rentalId, duration tiers, live prices, and LIVE STOCK per duration — skip tiers marked OUT OF STOCK. US/UK numbers are real mobile (non-VoIP); Canada is VoIP. Not allowed for banking/financial/crypto-exchange verification. Purchase with rent_sms_number.

tools.name: search_keep_numbers
tools.description: Keep a Number: browse US real mobile numbers (not VoIP) locked to ONE app (Signal, WhatsApp, Telegram, Google, Discord, ...) or to "allservices" (receives any sender), rented 30 or 90 days so the user can RE-VERIFY later on the same number. A quick one-time code number is gone by then; use this when the user wants to keep the account. Omit query for the popular apps, or search about 2,000 apps by name. Returns each app's service id in [brackets] with live 30/90 day prices. Not offered for financial, gambling, or government services. Buy with rent_keep_number.

query.description: App name to search (e.g. "Signal", "Proton", "Discord"). Omit for the popular apps.

tools.name: order_sms_verification
tools.description: Buy a QUICK SMS verification number: returns a temporary phone number the user enters on the target service, then the incoming code is read with check_sms_verification. This SPENDS the wallet balance (typically $0.50-$5). Single-use, valid 20 minutes, auto-refunds if no SMS arrives. Use search_sms_services and get_sms_service_countries first to pick serviceId and countryId. Requires a connected agent wallet.

countryId.description: The countryId from get_sms_service_countries (defaults to United States)

requestId.description: Idempotency key: generate a fresh UUID for each NEW order, and reuse the SAME value when retrying after a timeout or transport error — an identical retry returns the original order instead of charging again. Use a NEW id when deliberately ordering another number.

tools.name: check_sms_verification
tools.description: Poll a quick SMS order for the incoming verification code. Read-only. Call every 15-30 seconds after order_sms_verification until status is "received", then relay the code (and full message) to the user. Orders auto-refund if nothing arrives within 20 minutes. Requires a connected agent wallet.

orderId.description: The Order ID returned by order_sms_verification (also listed by list_sms_orders)

tools.name: cancel_sms_verification
tools.description: Cancel a quick SMS order that is still waiting for a code and refund it to the wallet immediately. Refused if the SMS was already delivered (read it with check_sms_verification instead). Requires a connected agent wallet.

orderId.description: The Order ID of the waiting quick SMS order

tools.name: list_sms_orders
tools.description: List this wallet's SMS orders — quick verification orders (with their Order IDs) and long-term rentals (with their receipt IDs, numbers, and expiry dates). Read-only. Use it to re-find an order ID or check what is still active. Requires a connected agent wallet.

tools.name: rent_sms_number
tools.description: Rent a LONG-TERM receive-only SMS number: the user keeps the same number for the whole rental and can receive multiple SMS (fair-use 25/day). This SPENDS the wallet balance. Use list_sms_rentals first for rentalId, valid day tiers, prices, and live stock (do not order an OUT OF STOCK tier). Extendable before expiry with extend_sms_rental, and, for tiers longer than 15 days only, cancellable for a full refund with cancel_sms_rental within 2 hours if no messages arrived (tiers of 15 days or less are NON-REFUNDABLE once purchased — say so before buying one). Not allowed for banking/financial/crypto-exchange verification. Requires a connected agent wallet.

rentalId.description: The rentalId from list_sms_rentals (e.g. 11 for United States)

days.description: Rental duration in days — must be one of the duration tiers list_sms_rentals shows for this rentalId

requestId.description: Idempotency key: generate a fresh UUID for each NEW rental, and reuse the SAME value when retrying after a timeout or transport error — an identical retry returns the original rental instead of charging again.

tools.name: rent_keep_number
tools.description: Rent a Keep a Number line: a US real mobile number for one app (or "allservices" = any sender) for 30 or 90 days. This SPENDS the wallet balance. Use search_keep_numbers first for the service id and live price. The result gives a receiptId that works with get_sms_rental_messages, extend_sms_rental (wallet only) and cancel_sms_rental. Some numbers can be cancelled for a full refund for a short time after purchase if no message arrived; otherwise NON-REFUNDABLE once bought, so confirm with the user before buying. Not for financial, gambling, or government verification. Requires a connected agent wallet.

requestId.description: Idempotency key: generate a fresh UUID for each NEW number, and reuse the SAME value when retrying after a timeout or transport error — an identical retry returns the original number instead of charging again.

tools.name: get_sms_rental_messages
tools.description: Read the inbox of a long-term SMS rental: all received messages, newest first, plus the number's status and expiry. Read-only; poll it when the user expects a message. The receiptId comes from rent_sms_number or list_sms_orders. Requires a connected agent wallet.

receiptId.description: The rental receipt ID from rent_sms_number or list_sms_orders

tools.name: extend_sms_rental
tools.description: Extend a long-term SMS rental so the user keeps the same number — days are ADDED on top of the current expiry. This SPENDS the wallet balance at the live tier price (the tool checks the price first and reports what was charged). Valid day options are the same duration tiers the rental was offered at. Extend BEFORE expiry; an expired rental usually cannot be recovered. Requires a connected agent wallet.

days.description: How many days to add — one of the rental's duration tiers (see list_sms_rentals for this country)

tools.name: cancel_sms_rental
tools.description: Cancel a long-term SMS rental and refund the full amount to the wallet. Only works for rentals LONGER than 15 days, within 2 hours of purchase, AND only if the number has NOT received any message — this mirrors the provider refund rules, so a 15-day-or-shorter rental, a passed window, or a code that already arrived returns a clear reason and refunds nothing. Use for a genuine change of mind or a wrong purchase shortly after renting. The receiptId comes from rent_sms_number or list_sms_orders. Requires a connected agent wallet.

receiptId.description: The rental receipt ID from rent_sms_number or list_sms_orders
